finding: ascension_qwen80_source_token_multi_layer_same_runtime_device takes ONE flag, --l1-full-layer-assessment, whose required schema differs by mode. --mode preflight refuses anything but hawking.ascension.qwen80_l1_full_layer_completion_assessment.v1; --mode metal refuses anything but hawking.ascension.qwen80_l0_l1_joint_post_capture_assessment.v1, which the shared L0+L1 finalizer requires as provenance. No single document satisfies both, so the multi-layer capture cannot be run as built.
fix: The host must accept BOTH documents - the L1 completion assessment for preflight validation and the joint post-capture assessment as metal-path provenance - via separate flags.
note: Both refusals named observed and expected values, which is why this cost one reaped child instead of repeated blind captures. This is the fifth producer/consumer field-or-schema drift found in this campaign and the first that makes a path impossible rather than merely awkward.
